entries.en: to cast the net; to throw out a fishing net
entries.notes: 首音节声调号 T99 污损；语义据 hechar la red 与'抛网'(poa báng) 可定，按 T99 规程降级。

entries.en: to shift, transfer (the blame); to lay the fault on another

entries.zh: 赖（诬赖、把罪责推赖于人；亦指抵赖）
entries.en: to pin the blame on someone; to shirk or deny one's fault
to impute, ascribe (a fault); to lay the blame on
to point at; to point the finger at, accuse

entries.zh: 歪（歪赖、冤枉，谓将罪责歪加于人；字面义'不正'）
entries.en: crooked, askew; (here) to distort, to wrong someone with an unjust blame
entries.notes: 歪字面为'不正'，置于 echar la culpa 条下取诬枉、歪赖之义，属上下文推断。

entries.en: to reproach to one's face; to cast faults in someone's face

entries.zh: 泼水、浇洒（西语限定语 azioba 待考，或为 açíbar 芦荟水）
entries.en: to pour, splash water (qualifier 'de azioba' unresolvable; possibly aloe water)
entries.notes: 'azioba' 无法确解，灝/liām 配对亦异常（灝或为'灑'形近字），仅'泼水'大义可据。

entries.zh: 败（毁败、糟蹋；'echar a mal' 弄坏之义）
entries.en: to ruin, spoil; to undo, destroy
entries.notes: 汉字栏形近作'敢'，据音写 pay(pāi) 与 hechar a mal, deshacer 当为'敗'之形讹。

entries.zh: 转倒、倾注（西文 'aboca de jamo' 难解，释义存疑）
entries.en: to pour out, decant (Spanish phrase 'aboca de jamo' unresolvable)
entries.notes: 西文短语与音写 tīn chúy 均无法确解，据汉字'轉'暂取倾倒转注之义，存疑。

entries.en: to throw away, cast out; to take away

entries.zh: 除（除去、赶除；音写后段残泐难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: to remove, cast out (latter part of the Hokkien transcription garbled)
entries.notes: 末声调号 T99、音写尾串 cyparcù 难辨；'除(chū)、赶(cùa)'大意可据，余待考。

entries.en: to take away, carry off
to drive out, chase away
to drive them apart, scatter; to separate

entries.zh: 斟（斟酒；此条西文谓泼酒于面）
entries.en: to pour (wine); to dash wine in someone's face
to expel, banish; to dismiss

entries.zh: 除开去（除掉、挪开置一旁）
entries.en: to remove and set aside; to cast out
to take out, extract
entries.notes: 西文残句 logetabaje ar los of 难解，释义据汉字'取出'与音写 chiū chiūs。

entries.zh: 跋卦（掷筊抽签、卦卜问神；西文谓于神像前掷筊）
entries.en: to divine by casting lots / the kua; to throw divination lots before an idol
entries.notes: 西文 fueras/fuertes 当读 suertes（掷筊问卜），melante alydolo 或为 delante al ídolo；汉字'跋卦'与 poa cùa 互证，大义无疑。

entries.zh: 跋杯（掷杯珓筊杯问神；'桮'字原件存疑，或作'柸'）
entries.en: to throw the divination blocks (poe) for an oracle
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:桮/柸]；据音写 poa púe 与 echar suertes 定为掷筊。

entries.en: to divine, to cast the kua; fortune-telling by divination blocks
entries.notes: 西文 fuertes 当读 suertes（掷筊占卜），与汉字'卜卦'、音写 poa cúa 互证。

entries.zh: 阴杯（即'陰杯'：掷筊两枚皆俯覆、神意不允之兆）
entries.en: the yin throw — casting the divination blocks so both fall face-down (an unfavorable oracle)
entries.notes: 汉字'隱'据音写 im 当为'陰'之同音借字；西文 vcaer boca abais 即 caer boca abajo（俯面而落），与陰杯义互证。
